claim_boundary: A realization_free verdict is exhaustive for the profile: every physical realization of its totals and minima, at every cardinality of every role and every witness identity, admits a complete EFX allocation within the support-edge budget.  It rests on Lemma B (a slack-two role has the forced two-good column) and the cardinality-free form of Lemma C (an unsplit role of any width is exactly modelled by its total and its minimum).  It does not establish chart coverage or the universal fixed-U theorem.
